title: AI Stem Generation End-to-End Processing Facade / Crash-Recovery Composition
contracts: A25 persists generation identity and source mix format before A22 runtime execution
repeated begin never reissues runtime start once an A21 record exists
START_CALL_IN_FLIGHT may restart only when the intact A21 ledger proves GEN_RECORD_NOT_FOUND before any A22 external start could occur
ambiguous or possibly-issued start resumes by A22 reconciliation rather than blind start replay
runtime READY is not mixer publication; A23 mix compatibility remains mandatory
A22 project-controlled output SHA is rechecked before A23
normalization-required state cannot skip A23 normalization provenance
A23 active variant must exist before A24 retention registration
crash after variant activation resumes retention only and does not re-run generation
logical cancellation is durable before external cancel and an in-flight cancel is never blindly resent after crash
cancelled generation cannot be promoted to mixer-ready output
delete before a registered generated variant is forbidden
delete reason is durably bound by the A25 delete-resume adapter and a changed reason is rejected
delete crash resumes the same A24 destructive operation without generation reexecution
public facade evidence contains hashes/state/format metadata and no raw logical generation id, prompt, execution id, paths, credentials or audio
